annotations.title: List video transmissions of a day

description: List video transmissions (transmisje) from the Sejm on one day: plenary and committee sittings and other events, with title, type, room, start time and links to the player and the video.

date.description: Day of the transmissions, in YYYY-MM-DD format; defaults to today

term.description: Term of the Sejm (kadencja), e.g. 10; defaults to the current term (see get-terms)

name: get-videos-by-date

type.description: Kind of event, e.g. posiedzenie (plenary sitting) or komisja (committee)

notice.description: Set when the Sejm API is unavailable and the data comes from a cache; it may be out of date

title: List video transmissions of a day
